name: web/Password reset poisoning X-Forwarded-Host
description: [mid] Password reset poisoning via X-Forwarded-Host (CWE-640; PortSwigger host-header password-reset poisoning, real-world GHSA-cgj8-7m5q-x5gv): the reset link is built from a client-controlled header, so the emailed token lands on the attacker origin. Keywords: password reset poisoning host header x-forwarded-host token hijack account. ctrl: without the header the link points at the legit origin -> not falsified. base_url = site root; response must reflect the link (labs/dev) — for prod mail, chain with the elite JWT/OAuth skills.
